capture: recorded-sequences.jsonl is a hand-reduced excerpt of six recorded step repairs (G1 stage 3a campaigns 3a13, 3a14, 3a15). Each line names its source events.jsonl (home directory replaced by <user>), the SHA-256 of that file, the source commit the campaign binary was built from, and the physical event line range. Only the seed, provider-turn tool outcomes, feedback stage, rejection counts, and stop are kept; provider_turn_duration and context_truncation_suspected lines are omitted. The recorded events do not store the feedback text sent to the model, so no feedback text is quoted.
